'''Kiyotaki Shrine''' (清瀧神社 / 清滝神社) refers to Shinto shrines located across Japan.

* [[Kiyotaki Shrine (Nikkō City)]] - Located in [[Nikkō|Nikkō City]], [[Tochigi Prefecture]].
* [[Seiryū Shrine (Urayasu)]] - Located in [[Urayasu|Urayasu City]], [[Chiba Prefecture]].
* [[Kiyotaki Shrine (Kanazawa City)]] - Located in [[Kanazawa|Kanazawa City]], [[Ishikawa Prefecture]].
* [[Kiyotaki Shrine (Ōno City)]] - Located in [[Ōno, Fukui|Ōno City]], [[Fukui Prefecture]].
* [[Kiyotaki Shrine (Ōno City Tomoe)]] - Located in Tomoe, Ōno City, Fukui Prefecture.
* [[Kiyotaki Shrine (Ōno City Nakasaba)]] - Located in Nakasaba, Ōno City, Fukui Prefecture.
